document_data.title: Referral for Cardiology Consultation
document_data.content:
To: Dr. Osei

Subject: Referral for Cardiology Consultation for Michael Johnson

Dear Dr. Osei,

I am writing to refer Michael Johnson, a 58-year-old male, who has been experiencing exertional dyspnea. During his last consultation on October 20, 2026, his blood pressure was recorded at 140/90. Unfortunately, there are no BNP results on file for him to review.

Given his history of hypertension and current symptoms, I believe a cardiology evaluation is warranted to rule out any underlying cardiac issues.

Please let us know if you require any further information or specific lab results to assist in his evaluation.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Position]
[Your Clinic]
